research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Methods and Systems for Providing Medical Insights describes managing data by constructing a digital model of a user with demographic, medical, and activity features, then applying a classifier model to identify feature sets and generate medical insights. This aligns with Function Health’s health platform that uses lab tests and user data to monitor health, indicating work on data driven medical insight generation and personalized health modeling.

about_short_description.short_description: Function is a health platform offering lab tests to help individuals monitor their health.

product.name: Function Membership
product.description: An annual preventive-health membership that provides comprehensive laboratory testing, clinician-reviewed results, longitudinal health tracking, and personalized action plans.

product.name: Function MRI and CT Scans
product.description: An imaging service that provides optional MRI and low-dose CT scans for evaluating anatomical changes, cardiovascular risk, lung findings, and signs associated with various diseases.

product.name: Function Add-On Tests
product.description: Optional laboratory panels that extend the standard membership with testing for cancer signals, brain-health risk, environmental exposures, allergies, sexual health, fertility, and other biomarkers.

product.name: Function for Work
product.description: An employer health benefit that provides employees and adult dependents with Function memberships, onboarding support, engagement tools, and aggregated program reporting.

product.name: Concierge Blood Draws
product.description: An optional blood-draw service that brings Function’s laboratory collection process to a customer’s selected location in eligible service areas.
